_source: Register symbols (ELF absolute sections) and bit-field layouts (DWARF) of CodeWarrior S12(X) v5.1's compiled lib/HC12c/src/mc9s12xdp512.c (mc9s12xdp512.c.o from github.com/TheTrueTrooper/C-Libs-For-CNT9S12XDP512Mirco-Using-MC9S12XDP512-Chip). Format: NAME -> [address, size, bits[[name,lsb,width]], overlaps[[byteName,bits]]]. Names are C identifiers: TIE_bit / NAME_grp are C artifacts for TIE / NAME.
